answer: Each identity must post a 500-token bond and pass a one-per-hardware credential check, so every registry entry maps to one physical device. A fake identity locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs, and slashing removes 100% of the bond on proven duplication, a cost with no meadow. Splitting an identity gains nothing because marginal cost per fake entry stays at 500 tokens, shared penalties extend to the whole cluster, and independent jurors flag a nadir of repeated attestations, leaving no whisper of profit.
